name: Wright Valley · McMurdo Dry Valleys

imagery.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026 (Sentinel-2 L2A, 2 escena(s): S2B_MSIL2A_20260123T202619_R042_T57CWP_20260123T214336, S2B_MSIL2A_20260123T202619_R042_T57CWQ_20260123T214336), processed by ESA; distributed via Microsoft Planetary Computer
imagery.product: Sentinel-2 L2A B04/B03/B02 (10 m) mosaic masked only for missing data (SCL = 0); fill scenes are matched to the base scene with per-band gain/offset (least squares over common clear pixels), 1024 px over the 19200 m window (edges = window bbox), area average at 18.75 m/px; common linear stretch [0.068, 0.7388] of reflectance and gamma 1/1.2 (the same stretch as the scenario image, so both join).

dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Planetary Computer cop-dem-glo-30), promediado a 200 m

centerBias.definition: context − scenario (m), mean of the central 2.4 km

environment.atmosphere: N₂ 78 % · O₂ 21 % · ~101 kPa at sea level (lower with altitude)

sampling.frame: local azimuthal equidistant centered on `center` (row 0 = north, column 0 = west) · WGS84
sampling.node: area average of the 200 m cell centered on the node

notes: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 heights (same product as the measured window; DSM, EGM2008 orthometric heights) sampled bilinearly on a 25 m azimuthal equidistant sub-grid centered on the site and averaged into 200 m cells (trapezoidal weights) for each node. Row 0 = north, column 0 = west.

Imagery: over Antarctic ice the SCL classification confuses bright snow/ice with cloud and shaded slopes with cloud shadow, so it is not used for masking; the mosaic joins tiles from the same pass as the scenario image (same date and illumination) and may keep real clouds if present.
centerBiasM = -4.6 m: mean of the 13×13 central context nodes (2.4 km) = 617.1 m versus the scenario grid mean = 621.7 m. The frontend subtracts this bias so the context joins the measured window.
Lower-resolution context to fill the horizon around the measured 2400 m window; it is not measured data of that window and does not enter metrics or comparisons (metrics = null).
